WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4

290
WW Pro Flow Zones Miracle V4 is a trend-following and flow-based trading indicator designed to identify high-probability trading opportunities.

Features

Smart Buy & Sell Signals
Institutional Flow Zones
Dynamic Support & Resistance
Trend Confirmation Filter
Optimized Risk/Reward Setups
Clean, Minimal Interface
Suitable for Scalping, Intraday and Swing Trading

Recommended Markets

Bitcoin (BTC)
Gold (XAUUSD)
Major Forex Pairs
US Indices

Recommended Timeframes

BTC: 5m & 10m
Gold: 15m & 45m

Notes

This indicator is intended to assist traders by highlighting high-conviction setups. It should be used together with proper risk management and market context. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

Open-source script

In true TradingView spirit, the creator of this script has made it open-source, so that traders can review and verify its functionality. Kudos to the author! While you can use it for free, remember that republishing the code is subject to our House Rules.
